stem: Both animals have structures that help them survive. Which sentence best describes the function of the structures that these animals have in common?

options.label: F
options.text: Both animals have small eyes that help them see clearly at night.

options.label: G
options.text: Both animals have tough skin to keep them warm in cold weather.

options.label: H
options.text: Both animals have sharp claws that help them to dig in sand.

options.label: J
options.text: Both animals have pointed tails to attract predators.

notes: The question asks to identify the function of common structures from the images and text.
